items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: I know one was Johnny Christian. ... Well those fellas are much younger men than I am I know.

ctx.x: Yeah I knew them well. I knew them well. There was Johnny Christian and another one. Well I wasn't so much acquainted with the names but I know one was Johnny Christian.
Emil Christian is still living. Frank Christian was a carnet player too. Yeah. Emil still plays trombone and bass. Mm-hmm.
Well those fellas are much younger men than I am I know.
